name: PQRS
source:
Set in a fictional elite high school in the sunny lands of Singapore, PQRS the Game explores how a class of brilliant students comes to terms with each other's conflicting beliefs as they decide who their Class Representative should be. Possibility of romance, but it's not really the point.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=10796]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
《PQRS》的舞台是阳光明媚的新加坡，一所虚构的精英高中里。班上一群才华横溢的学生要选出班级代表，也不得不在此过程中正视彼此冲突的信念。故事中或许会萌生恋情，但那并非真正的重点。

[引自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=10796]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
